M8B intrinsic-format fixture record

Source
------
The three files named below are deterministic test-only derivatives of the
checked-in Cantarell-Regular.ttf fixture in this directory:

  RunenUIFixtureColr-Regular.ttf
  RunenUIFixtureSvg-Regular.ttf
  RunenUIFixtureBitmap-Regular.ttf

The source font is Cantarell Regular, obtained from the Cantarell project and
redistributed here under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Its complete notice is
in Cantarell-Regular.OFL.txt. The derivatives retain the source outlines and
metadata and add only the intrinsic table needed by the corresponding M8B
classification proof.

License
-------
The added fixture tables and their test-only construction are provided under
the same SIL Open Font License 1.1 terms as the source fixture. These files are
not runtime assets and are included only to make the production-path tests
independent of host-installed fonts.
